policy: Every tool generated from `jit --schema` appears exactly once in `include` or `exclude`, with a one-line rationale.
Include a command when an autonomous agent drives it directly: find work, claim it, inspect it, transition it, check gates, read repository structure.
Exclude interactive setup, destructive operations, registry and host administration, alias spellings, and human-ergonomics reporting.
A command hidden in the CLI schema is always excluded here; this manifest may narrow the set further, never widen it.
Adding a CLI command fails the coverage test until it is curated. `JIT_MCP_ALL_TOOLS=1` exposes the full generated set for operators who want it.

max_curated_tools is the ceiling the test suite enforces: the curated count plus 11 slots (25% headroom). One maintenance batch's worth of deliberate inclusions fits without touching the bound; the next one forces a re-curation, which is the point of the bound. Each advertised tool spends client context, so the ceiling is a budget rather than a formality.

include.jit_status: Repository-wide counts: the cheapest orientation call an agent can make.
include.jit_query_available: The find-work query: ready, unassigned, unblocked.
include.jit_query_all: General issue query with filters; the base every narrower listing specialises.
include.jit_query_blocked: Names the unmet dependencies behind work that is not ready.
include.jit_query_count: Aggregates issues into counts by dimension, for progress reporting without fetching records.
include.jit_query_divergence: Reports membership labels that disagree with DAG containment, so an agent can repair what it wired.
include.jit_issue_create: Primary write path for new work.
include.jit_issue_batch-create: Creates a wave of issues and their dependency edges in one call, the shape a breakdown produces.
include.jit_issue_update: The single transition and field-edit entry point, including state changes.
include.jit_issue_show: Full issue record: description, labels, gates, dependencies.
include.jit_issue_status: Compact state, per-gate readiness, and unmet dependencies for one or more issues.
include.jit_issue_children: Direct children of a container, resolved from the DAG.
include.jit_issue_progress: Counts a container's children by state, the rollup a coordinating agent polls.
include.jit_issue_claim: Assigns an issue and promotes it to in_progress in one step.
include.jit_issue_claim-next: Picks and claims the next ready issue, the autonomous worker's entry point.
include.jit_issue_release: Returns a claimed issue to the pool when an agent stops working on it.
include.jit_issue_reject: Terminal outcome for work an agent determines should not be done.
include.jit_dep_add: Wires the dependency DAG, the structure the whole tracker is built on.
include.jit_dep_rm: Corrects a wrong edge, the inverse of dep add.
include.jit_graph_deps: Upstream dependencies of an issue: what must finish first.
include.jit_graph_rdeps: Downstream dependents: what finishing this issue unblocks.
include.jit_graph_tree: DAG-resolved containment hierarchy, the authoritative parent/child view.
include.jit_gate_list: Enumerates gate definitions so an agent can name the gate it must satisfy.
include.jit_gate_add: Attaches a required gate to an issue during planning.
include.jit_gate_evaluate: Runs a gate checker or records a manual attestation.
include.jit_gate_evaluate-all: Runs every required gate on an issue, fail-fast, before requesting completion.
include.jit_gate_status: Reads recorded gate runs, including structured findings to act on.
include.jit_gate_status-all: Readiness of every required gate on an issue: the completion precondition.
include.jit_gate_fail: Records a failed gate when an agent detects the failure outside a checker run.
include.jit_claim_acquire: Takes the advisory work lease that coordinates concurrent agents.
include.jit_claim_renew: Extends a held lease while long work continues.
include.jit_claim_release: Returns a held lease, the inverse of acquire.
include.jit_doc_add: Links a durable document artifact to the issue that produced it.
include.jit_doc_list: Discovers the documents linked to an issue.
include.jit_doc_show: Reads linked document content, usually a spec an agent implements against.
include.jit_doc_dir: Names the canonical artifact directory an issue owns in a declared area, so an agent writes its work product where the convention puts it instead of composing the path.
include.jit_doc_conformance: Advisory sweep naming artifacts that sit outside their owning issue's canonical directory, so an agent can repair what it filed rather than leaving the drift for a maintainer.
include.jit_doc_remove: Unlinks a document reference, the inverse of doc add.
include.jit_item_show: Resolves a qualified id that an agent encounters in issue text.
include.jit_item_list: Enumerates addressable items by their configured kind, for discovering project knowledge.
include.jit_item_search: Finds an addressable item by text when the self-id is unknown.
include.jit_label_namespaces: Lists declared label namespaces, which an agent needs to write a label accepted by the repository's configuration.
include.jit_label_values: Lists values in use in a namespace, so an agent reuses the project vocabulary.
include.jit_profile_list: Lists the offline workflow packages the connected repository's own records name.
include.jit_profile_show: Inspects a profile manifest and package identity before an agent applies it.
include.jit_profile_apply: Dry-runs or recoverably applies a workflow package to the current repository.
include.jit_search: Text search across issues and documents in one call.
include.jit_apply: Instantiates a graph template into a container, the plan-before-fan-out scaffold.
include.jit_validate: Repository integrity check; an agent runs it before handing work back.

exclude.jit_init: Repository bootstrap, run once by a human before any agent connects.
exclude.jit_serve: Starts a long-lived HTTP server; host process lifecycle sits outside the tool surface.
exclude.jit_hooks_install: One-time git hook installation during repository setup.
exclude.jit_recover: Repair routine for a damaged repository; a human decides when to run it.
exclude.jit_migrate_lifecycle-timestamps: One-shot backfill run once per repository upgrade.
exclude.jit_version: Build provenance; the host, not the agent, decides CLI compatibility.
exclude.jit_worktree_info: Worktree identity is host state the agent already has from its shell.
exclude.jit_worktree_list: Fleet-wide worktree inspection is a coordinating lead's view.
exclude.jit_events_tail: Event-log forensics; agents act on current state rather than history.
exclude.jit_events_query: Event-log forensics; agents act on current state rather than history.
exclude.jit_graph_export: Bulk graph dump whose payload dwarfs a tool response; tree, deps, and rdeps answer the same questions incrementally.
exclude.jit_graph_roots: Root listing is a special case of query available for an agent looking for work.
exclude.jit_query_closed: Filter over query all on terminal states.
exclude.jit_query_strategic: Filter over query all on repository-declared strategic namespaces.
exclude.jit_issue_list: The CLI declares it equivalent to query all; the query group is the curated entry point.
exclude.jit_item_resolve: Alias of item show; one spelling per operation.
exclude.jit_issue_search: search covers issues and documents in one call.
exclude.jit_issue_delete: Destructive; unwanted work is rejected or archived through issue update.
exclude.jit_issue_assign: Assignment without workflow semantics; claim and release carry those.
exclude.jit_issue_unassign: Assignment without workflow semantics; claim and release carry those.
exclude.jit_claim_status: Lease outcome is returned by acquire and renew; standalone inspection is a lead-side view.
exclude.jit_claim_list: Fleet-wide lease inspection belongs to the coordinating lead.
exclude.jit_claim_heartbeat: Keepalive for indefinite leases; bounded leases are extended with renew.
exclude.jit_claim_force-evict: Destructive admin override of another worker's lease.
exclude.jit_config_get: Configuration lookup is a repository-setup concern.
exclude.jit_config_set: Mutates repository configuration; a maintainer decision.
exclude.jit_config_show: Configuration inspection is a repository-setup concern.
exclude.jit_config_show-hierarchy: Type-hierarchy inspection is a repository-setup concern.
exclude.jit_config_validate: Configuration linting is a maintainer chore.
exclude.jit_archive_document: Artifact lifecycle administration; operators explicitly choose when a document plan may publish or delete files.
exclude.jit_archive_container: Container-wide artifact lifecycle administration; operators review the complete plan before mutation.
exclude.jit_archive_candidates: Repository-wide archival reporting is a coordinating maintainer view rather than an issue worker operation.
exclude.jit_doc_history: Commit history of a document; git answers this where an agent already works.
exclude.jit_doc_diff: Version diffing of prose is a human review activity.
exclude.jit_doc_check-links: Link auditing is a maintainer chore; validate covers agent-facing integrity.
exclude.jit_doc_assets_list: Asset bookkeeping under a document, below the granularity an agent works at.
exclude.jit_gate_define: Gate registry administration; the registry is authored in .jit/gates.toml.
exclude.jit_gate_update: Gate registry administration; the registry is authored in .jit/gates.toml.
exclude.jit_gate_remove: Gate registry administration; the registry is authored in .jit/gates.toml.
exclude.jit_gate_show: Single-gate definition detail; gate list gives an agent the keys it needs.
exclude.jit_gate_preset_list: Preset administration, applied when a project is configured.
exclude.jit_gate_preset_show: Preset administration, applied when a project is configured.
exclude.jit_gate_preset_apply: Bulk-writes gates onto issues; a maintainer decision.
exclude.jit_gate_preset_create: Preset authoring is a maintainer chore.
exclude.jit_project_render: Projects configured item registries into documentation; a maintainer chore.
exclude.jit_invariant_check: Enforcement-drift report for maintainers; validate covers agent-facing integrity.
